incident_text: De fortes inondations touchent un quartier résidentiel de Nabeul. Plusieurs routes sont bloquées et l'eau continue de monter.

result.scene_summary: A town square is flooded with brown water, submerging the lower floors of multi-story buildings. A stop sign and directional signs are partially submerged.

observations.description: Brown floodwater covers the entire square, reaching up to the doors of buildings.
Multi-story buildings with windows, doors, and balconies; some with signs or logos.
No vehicles visible in the flooded area.
Traffic signs including a stop sign and a blue directional arrow sign.
